summary: WHISPERS: Realm of the Nine is a fantasy MMO across the Lantern March, where the Reach hub connects race-origin stories, wilderness and distant landmarks. MMORPG Tools owns character/realm lifecycle and modular UI; the ordered player template composes movement, class combat, quests, commerce and flight, while streamed scenes and YAML data provide world content.
places: places/main-menu-land/ - realm roster and entry point for Enter World and character creation.
places/character-creation-land/ - race/class/appearance selection, preview character and creation camera.
places/main/config.yaml - streamed Lantern March terrain, coast, roads, scatter and atmosphere; scene cells add landmarks including Veilgate Aerie.
places/main/cells/x0z0.scene - Lantern's Reach hub, services, residents, quest interactions and Corin at the dock watch.
places/main/cells/x0z-1.scene and x-5z0.scene, x-5z1.scene, x-6z0.scene, x-6z1.scene - Lantern Ward Marchfolk origin and Rootwake Glade Briarkin origin, their residents and quest marks.
places/main/cells/x1z0.scene - Emberstone Quarry camp, scavenger manager and quarry objectives.
places/main/cells/x7z-1.scene and x7z-2.scene - Cinderhold's Emberstone Cradle Kharic origin: Yurra, Kiv, Dren and Mira, quest-mark set pieces and north tunnel scavengers.
places/main/cells/x2z11.scene - Gullrest's Breakwater Strand Saltborn origin: Sena, Ruun, Sari, tide posts, coast lamps, wreck, phantom current and ferry buoys.
roots: world.config.yaml - main-menu-land default entry; binds player/camera templates, MMORPG UI, arrival redirect, routing and realm pulse.
mods/mmorpg-tools/mod-mmorpg/mod.json - registers MMORPG lifecycle, camera, character and interaction behaviors and UI actions.
templates/player.js#player - ordered locomotion, movement, Vanguard, Arcanist, Pathfinder, quest, vendor and flight behaviors.
templates/camera.js#camera - camera template used by gameplay controls and separate MMORPG creation/menu camera paths.
places/main/config.yaml - owns continent terrain and regional surface/scatter configuration; scene cells add local landmarks and interactions.
mods/gavi/mod.json - registers Gavi crew behavior and panel, the builder-facing companion tools.
shared: mods/mmorpg-tools/mod-mmorpg/lib/ - RPG registries, realm persistence, currency and UI modules reused by MMORPG behaviors, gameplay scripts and ui.js.
mods/mmorpg-tools/mod-mmorpg/lib/realm-save.js - character load/upsert/delete and roster population shared by menu and player lifecycle.
scripts/lib/data/realms.yml - routing and realm-pulse room registry; room IDs must align with realm-save.js.
scripts/lib/data/quests.yml + MMORPG lib/quest-data.js - quest definitions and eligibility/progress/status shared by quest-player, quest-giver and quest UI.
scripts/lib/economy.js + MMORPG lib/currency.js - copper transactions/ledger and denomination formatting shared by quests, vendor, flight and UI.
scripts/lib/regions.js + scripts/terrain-reach.js - regional classification and terrain/coast generation used by continent systems and region display.
scripts/lib/data/flights.yml - roost coordinates, region labels, discovery radius, fare/speed limits and clearance read by flight behavior and UI.

scripts/gen/shape.js and gen/house.js, hamlet.js, props.js, tree.js, rock.js, spire.js, farm.js, windmill*, frontier.js, briar.js, quarry.js, reach-*, elder-tree.js, roost.js, stone-bridge.js, veil.js, glade.js, ashfall.js, cradle.js and strand.js - procedural builders shared by place-cell bindings.
notableExports: scripts/arrival.js - onArrive, onLeave; scripts/routing.js - pickRoom; crons/realm-pulse.js - cron.
mods/mmorpg-tools/mod-mmorpg/main-menu-mgr.js - roster selection/hydration and lifecycle; character-select.js - preview lifecycle and input handling.
mods/mmorpg-tools/mod-mmorpg/player.js - character build/save/load and gameplay lifecycle; scripts/player.js - onInput/update; scripts/humanoid-locomotion.js - gait behavior.

mods/mmorpg-tools/mod-mmorpg/ui.js - UI composition/actions; lib/ui-quest.js - getPortrait, renderQuestDialog, renderTurnInDialog, renderQuestTracker; lib/version.js - GAME_VERSION 0.14.0 Alpha and GAME_TITLE.
scripts/flight.js - onInput/update; scripts/gryphon-flight.js - at/update; scripts/lib/regions.js - REGIONS, MARCH, regionAt.
scripts/quest-player.js - onInput/update; scripts/elric.js and scripts/townsfolk.js - resident behavior; scripts/lib/economy.js - realmOf, ledger, feedback, move.

mods/mmorpg-tools/mod-mmorpg/lib/quest-data.js - getAvailableQuests, questToActiveFormat, questProgress, questStatus, getQuest; scripts/gen/glade.js, veil.js, cradle.js and strand.js - geometry, collider.
scripts/scavengers.js and scripts/wolves.js - update; scripts/gen/props.js, rock.js and stone-bridge.js - geometry, collider.
ownership: scripts/player.js - room-local movement intent and velocity/footstep state; place config owns gravity.
scripts/humanoid-locomotion.js - transient gait/turn state, character yaw and animation channels; gait samples prior-tick movement velocity.
MMORPG player.js and lib/realm-save.js - active character, roster snapshots and persisted character records, including discovered roosts and quest state.
scripts/vanguard.js, arcanist.js and pathfinder.js - class action/cooldown/combat state; scripts/wolves.js and scripts/scavengers.js - creature AI, health, targets and death/respawn state.
scripts/quest-player.js - quest/tally, inventory/xp/dialog/cache state, quest marks/flags and deferred owedItems; woodcutting owns tree fall/regrowth presentation.
scripts/lib/economy.js - coin movement, purse floor and ledger writes; scripts/vendor.js owns shop state and transaction handling.
scripts/flight.js - per-player discovered roosts, flightMap, flying/landing state and nearby-roost hint; scripts/gryphon-flight.js owns spawned mount route and rider landing.
MMORPG ui.js/lib/ui-* render player/mod state; ui-zone-splash.js owns transient client splash timing; Gavi equipe.js owns crew-watch/target state.
flows: world.config.yaml defaultPlace main-menu-land → main-menu-mgr/main-menu UI → realm roster or character selection → creation/enter-world → main gameplay lifecycle.
Arrival outside main-menu-land without fresh _worldEnterAt or creation-place _creationEnterAt → scripts/arrival.js redirects to main-menu-land; menu Enter/Create stamp transition exceptions.
main-menu-mgr loads current room SQL roster and population; api.enterPlace routes selected character to saved place/position; routing validates requested room, then last room, then main.
scripts/routing.js and crons/realm-pulse.js read realms.yml; room cron writes player count to realm_pulse, which realm-save reads for roster UI.
Character creation race/class → lib/races.js race start and character state → MMORPG player.js/realm-save upsert to realm characters table, keyed by user, realm and slot.
templates/player.js → humanoid-locomotion → player → Vanguard → Arcanist → Pathfinder → quest-player → vendor → flight; behavior order and shared inputs are significant.
moveX/moveZ/jump and orbit/steer/autorun → player.js and wow-move.js room-local intent → body motion under place gravity; camera controls consume camera/player state separately.
Attack/cast inputs → class abilities and scripts/lib/missiles.js → targets/enemies; wolves.js and scavengers.js consume hit/slow state written by class behaviors.
Interact/E → quest-player resolves NPCs, talkers, readable props, caches, timber and quest-mark objects; marks increment tally only for active incomplete objectives.
townsfolk.yml keyed by who + placed npc/talker state.who → scripts/townsfolk.js supplies greetings/lines; quest-player E advances dialogue and quest-giver/UI handles available quests.

scripts/lib/data/quests.yml → quest-data eligibility/progress/status → quest-player and quest-giver/UI; accept baselines objective tally, completion pays once via economy.move and items enter inventory or owedItems.
Race-origin chains MAR-01..08, THR-01..08, KHA-01..08 and NAM-01..08 → race-restricted quest data and quest-mark interactions; origin finale/turn-ins lead heroes toward Lantern's Reach.
behaviorFamilies: scripts/gen/house.js, hamlet.js, props.js, tree.js, rock.js, spire.js, farm.js, windmill*, frontier.js, briar.js, quarry.js, reach-*, elder-tree.js, roost.js, stone-bridge.js, veil.js, glade.js, ashfall.js, cradle.js and strand.js - procedural builders recur across place scenes, varied by kind and geometry parameters.
scripts/grass.js, flower.js, mushroom.js and pebble.js - terrain scatter geometry reused by place bindings, varied by layer density, scale, seed or per-item params.
scripts/gen/tree.js with scripts/tree-look.js - painted bark/alpha-cut foliage recur in forest layers and placed scatters, varied by tree kind and LOD.
scripts/flower.js and mushroom.js with their look materials - painted wildflower frames and mushroom caps vary by frame/cap parameters in terrain scatter.
MMORPG player.js, character-select.js and main-menu-mgr.js - coordinated character/menu lifecycle registered by mod.json.
MMORPG camera.js/camera-creation.js and menu-camera.js - gameplay, creation-preview and per-screen menu camera paths with phase/place guards.
MMORPG lib/ui-*.js, including ui-creation.js and ui-zone-splash.js - modular renderers composed/lazily loaded by ui.js for HUD, menus, creation, quests, travel and region presentation.
scripts/wolves.js and scripts/scavengers.js - enemy managers share roam/chase/attack/leash/death patterns, varied by YAML stats, enemy content and den/camp configuration.
migrationNotes: Money is one integer copper amount; 100 copper = 1 silver and 100 silver = 1 gold. Route transactions through scripts/lib/economy.js to preserve purse floor, ledger and UI feedback.
templates/player.js behavior order is significant: locomotion before movement, then classes, quests, vendor and flight; gait samples prior-tick velocity.
Movement intent/locomotion scratch is room-local ctx.session; scripts/player.js writes velocity while place config owns gravity.
Flight roost IDs in flights.yml must correspond to flattened pads and ground y values in main config; saved state.roosts is discovery record, coordinates use place-main meters.

Quest marks are scene entities tagged quest-mark with state.quest/state.mark; E counts only an active quest's incomplete objective. Wolf den or scavenger camp state may override pack/crew and tallyKey.

Quest records are race-restricted via race indices; quest chains use requires for their sequence and origin finals may specify turn-in NPCs. The introductory quests.yml comment still says origins are unbuilt/Q001 open to every hero despite the implemented origin chains.
